Actually Is
cards.alt: Skinvive is a hyaluronic acid microdroplet injectable, FDA approved May 2023 for cheek smoothness in adults over 21

title: Skinvive
vs Dermal Filler

cards.heading: What are the side effects of Skinvive?
title: Skinvive
Side Effects
cards.alt: Skinvive side effects are local and short-lived: small bumps, redness or bruising, temporary unevenness, and it dissolves

title: Semaglutide
Non-Response Is Real

cards.subject: semaglutide
cards.heading: How to Restart Weight Loss on Semaglutide
title: Restarting
Semaglutide
Progress
cards.alt: Five steps to restart semaglutide progress: confirm the dose, track composition, audit habits, get labs, then discuss switching
items: Confirm your dose and how long you have been on it
Track body composition, not just the scale
Audit protein, strength training and sleep
Get labs: thyroid, fasting insulin, HbA1c
Then ask about a supervised switch
